highlights.title: 2 first-party subdomains CNAME-cloaked to third-party trackers
highlights.detail: DNS CNAME uncloaking linked ssl.o.webmd.com, bytes.webmd.com to Adobe Experience Cloud, bytes.media.

highlights.title: First-party server-side tagging detected on 1 endpoint
highlights.detail: First-party hosts (ssl.o.webmd.com) carried Adobe Web SDK (First-Party Edge).

highlights.title: 1 high-entropy fingerprinting or DOM-replay signal observed
27 observed tracking companies not named in privacy policy
highlights.detail: Unmentioned in https://www.webmd.com/about-webmd-policies/about-privacy-policy: Adform, Adobe Experience Cloud, Amazon Ads, Criteo, DoubleVerify.

highlights.title: Contacted 79 third-party domains across 62 corporate groups
highlights.detail: 542 of 641 requests matched tracking services or Brave Shields filter rules (532 standard / 541 aggressive).
